summary: Frontend hardening sprint (Batch A + Batch B) tested on mobile viewport (390x844) with admin@equinesync.com. 9 of 11 requested checks pass. Two critical regressions found: (1) auto-focus does NOT land on the first field of the Incidents sheet — focus stays on the FAB because firstFieldRef is attached to a non-focusable <div> wrapper around the Radix Select; (2) the severity smart-default 'moderate' is NOT applied — Select trigger shows 'Choose…' and sessionStorage records severity:'' from the first debounce. Because severity is required, this cascades into two follow-on failures: the inline-error path can't be exercised, and Enter-to-submit success closure can't be verified. All other smart defaults (occurred_at=NOW, lessons start_time=next half-hour, lessons duration=60, training date=today), draft restore, draft clear on session removal, Today LastSyncedBadge text + tap-to-refresh, and FAB regressions are working as designed.

ui_bugs.issue: Auto-focus broken when the first field is a Select. firstFieldRef is attached to a wrapper <div> (line 182). divs are not focusable by default, so document.activeElement after the 320ms delay remains whatever it was before the sheet opened. Measured on /incidents (first field = severity Select): focused element was 'incidents-fab', not the first sheet input. Cursor is NOT 'ready in the first input' as the spec requires. Fix idea: when first field is a Select, focus the SelectTrigger (button); when textarea/input, focus that element directly. Easiest: give firstFieldRef to a focusable element only (the underlying SelectTrigger button), or fall back to querying the first focusable child of the sheet.

Severity smart-default 'moderate' from initialValues is NOT applied to the Select. After opening the /incidents sheet, the trigger shows the placeholder 'Choose…' and the debounced draft persisted to sessionStorage contains 'severity':'' even though initialValues={severity:'moderate'} was passed. The occurred_at default IS applied (2026-05-21T04:37), so the prop is reaching the sheet — but the Select is clobbering the moderate value to ''. Suspected cause: parent Incidents.jsx builds a fresh initialValues object every render — the useEffect deps include initialValues, so the effect re-runs and resets form to a new {} reference when Radix Select mounts and immediately fires onValueChange(''), or the Radix Select's controlled value is being normalized to '' on first render. Needs investigation in QuickAddSheet useEffect dep stability + how Select handles initial value.

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify. Test aborted /api/incidents POST via route abort, but client-side validation (severity required) returns before the network call because of bug #2 above. The toast 'Severity is required' fires and submit() returns early, so the inline-error <div data-testid='incidents-add-error'> never renders. The error rendering path itself looks correct in code; it's gated by the upstream severity bug.

integration_issues.flow: Incidents Enter-to-submit success + draft clear on success
integration_issues.issue: Same root cause. Pressed Enter in the title input with type set to 'injury' and description filled, but submit returned early on severity-required check. Sheet stayed open; sessionStorage was NOT cleared (still held title/description/type). Enter-to-submit native behaviour is wired correctly (verified by submit handler firing); blocked by severity default bug.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Make auto-focus actually land on the first interactive control. The current firstFieldRef wired to a <div> wrapper around <Select> never focuses anything. Options: (a) when first field is select, attach the ref to the SelectTrigger button; (b) fall back to sheetEl.querySelector('input, textarea, button[role="combobox"]')?.focus().

FIX (HIGH): Severity initialValues='moderate' is not being honored. Investigate (a) whether the parent's freshly-allocated initialValues object causes the useEffect to re-fire and reset form, and (b) whether the FormPrimitives Select fires onValueChange('') on mount when given a non-empty controlled value. Recommend memoizing initialValues in Incidents.jsx (and Lessons/Training) with useMemo so the reference is stable.

Once #2 is fixed, re-test Batch-B inline error path (data-testid='incidents-add-error' visible on POST failure, sheet stays open, form intact) and Enter-to-submit success path (sheet closes, sessionStorage key 'equine_draft_/incidents' removed).
Onboarding hidden recurring-schedules step / 9-step count: NOT verified this run (test session was already deep on hardening flows). Main agent can self-verify via /onboarding step count.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickAddSheet useEffect deps include initialValues (line 79). Parent pages (Incidents/Lessons/Training) construct a new object literal each render — the effect will re-run unnecessarily on every parent re-render. Recommend useMemo at the parent level or shallow-compare inside the effect.

firstFieldRef is attached to a <div> when first field is a Select (line 182). divs are not focusable; this silently makes the auto-focus feature a no-op for any sheet whose first field is a Select (Incidents is the prime example).

FormPrimitives Select uses `value={value || ''}` (line 26). If Radix's onValueChange fires with '' during mount when the supplied value doesn't perfectly match an item, the controlling parent loses the initial value. Worth instrumenting with a console.log to confirm.

Draft debouncer (line 84) writes severity:'' immediately on first render (visible in sessionStorage on first typing). Confirms the form state already has severity:'' before the user typed anything — i.e. the smart default was wiped between setForm(initial) and the first debounce flush.

All other Batch A/B checks already passing.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1 (auto-focus): firstFieldRef points at a <div> when first field is a Select — divs are not focusable, so .focus() is a no-op. Bug 2 (severity default lost): Either (a) parent re-renders with a new initialValues object literal causing useEffect to reset form, or (b) Radix Select fires onValueChange('') on mount. Both are reproducible 100% on /incidents. Mitigation: memoize initialValues in parent + attach firstFieldRef to a focusable child (SelectTrigger button, input, or textarea) only.
